# A square loop generated by matter

The complete Peter-Weyl source produces a gauge-invariant flux loop around
a contractible square through four actual fermion hops. The exact amplitudes
include the spin sign, quantum link normalization and a retained dual
reference. A singlet and a colored native block both have a strictly nonzero
matter-eliminated loop kernel and a positive finite-time detector probability,
with every complementary outcome retained. No magnetic term is added.

The result concerns finite source records. Autonomous gauge dynamics and a
physical gauge-field phase require separate results. See the
[proof](PROOF.md) and [exact receipt](results.json).

```sh
python -m model.coherent_defect_wave.chiral_joint.matter_induced_plaquette --check
python -m pytest -q model.coherent_defect_wave.chiral_joint.matter_induced_plaquette
```
